tool_gap_policy: Use the prior Terminal-Bench replay policy of zero additional tool delay
max_tokens_policy: Original Qwen replay budget rule max(8192, source completion tokens), with natural EOS
arrival_policy: All original roots count in the timed run. Offer the successors in a single window, released by their own original predecessor. Account for body-dependent ingress. The measured native route determines actual recoveries.

selection.calibration_purpose: Measure natural EOS in original windows while testing a larger feasible ready-restore workset; formal bandwidth verdict requires comparable generation work and matched routes.

arrival_order_screen.assumptions: Potential totals assume complete remote reads after P changes. Existing hybrid checkpoints, early root releases and actual P routing can reduce demand.

cold_arrival_guard.reason: Leave room for the first large HTTP request and the initial request-body preparation delays observed in the parent replay.
